description: Implementation of HttpResponseBodyDrainer class responsible for draining HTTP response bodies asynchronously, managing read buffers, timeouts, and connection reuse.

classes.name: HttpResponseBodyDrainer
classes.description: Handles asynchronous draining of HTTP response bodies with timeout and connection management.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins draining the response body, sets up timeout timer.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Executes the state machine for draining response body.

methods.name: DoDrainResponseBody
methods.description: Initiates reading response body into buffer.

methods.name: DoDrainResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation, checks for completion or errors.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback for I/O completion, continues the state machine.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Finalizes the draining process, closes stream, and cleans up.
